wages.text: Sponsored legislation requiring developers using its housing approval process to pay construction workers prevailing or union-level wages and meet additional labor standards.
wages.quote: Under Wicks’ bill, developers would have to pay union-level wages

housing.text: Authored AB 2011, which authorized streamlined, ministerial approval for qualifying multifamily housing developments in certain commercial zones.
housing.quote: This bill would create the Affordable Housing and High Road Jobs Act of 2022, which would authorize a development proponent to submit an application for a housing development that meets specified objective standards and affordability and site criteria

tax.text: Rendón supports progressive taxation of billionaires and wealthy residents to fund state programs.
tax.quote: “progressive taxation,” meaning he would tax billionaires and other wealthy residents more.

housing.text: Rendón proposes creating social housing in rent-controlled and mixed-income neighborhoods for unhoused Californians.
housing.quote: We can create social housing programs for unhoused Californians. Not projects, but housing in rent controlled and mixed income neighborhoods.

schools.text: Rendón identifies public education as a campaign priority and describes education as an investment.
schools.quote: PUBLIC EDUCATION : Education is an investment, not a debt sentence

immigration.text: Rendón says he would prohibit federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents from using state property and eliminate related detention centers.
immigration.quote: If elected, Rendón said he wants to ban federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents from using state property and get rid of any related detention centers.

health.text: Rendón supports implementing CalCare, described as Medicare for All in California.
health.quote: We must pass CalCare, Medicare for All, in California! Better quality healthcare for EVERYONE at a lower cost to the State.

energy.text: Rendón supports accelerating the transition to 100% renewable energy and replacing fossil fuels.
energy.quote: We have to accelerate the transition to 100% renewable energy.
